claims.section: 4 怎样理解免费给得太少或太多；5 怎样判断增量价值支持购买
claims.statement: Free-tier utility and optional paid differentiation are the source-backed premises. No universal allocation ratio, timing threshold, causal conversion effect or profitability guarantee is adopted.

claims.section: 6 订阅需要额外判断持续价值
claims.statement: Recurring access and enduring value motivate the distinction between initial purchase and renewal. Need recurrence, billing-period fit and changing expectations are conceptual interpretation, not retention forecasts.
